aim_summary.goal: Add one 1.5 millimetre rib to increase structural support and strength while preserving non-targeted geometry.
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The clevis mounting bracket contains one added 1.5 millimetre rib intended to increase support, strength, and resistance to deformation without unrelated geometry changes.

operations_plan.summary: Add a rib to the structural body of the clevis mounting bracket.

steps.description: Create and fuse a prismatic rib to the bracket after its attachment faces, profile, workplane, and interpretation of the 1.5 millimetre dimension are resolved.

expected_result.geometry: One rib with the requested 1.5 millimetre dimension is fused to the existing structural body.
expected_result.function: The added rib increases structural support and strength.
expected_result.behavior: The supported structure is intended to resist deformation under load more effectively.

validation_criteria.description: The final model contains exactly one added rib having the specified 1.5 millimetre dimension.
The added rib provides increased support to the structure.
The added rib makes the structure stronger.
The rib improves the structure's resistance to deformation under load.
Non-targeted existing geometry remains unchanged except where minimally necessary to fuse the rib.
